name: Suspicious Network Connection Binary No CommandLine
description: Detects suspicious network connections made by a well-known Windows binary run with no command line parameters
author: GAI_CTI
query: (network.direction:true AND (process.executable:(*\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\dllhost.exe)) AND (winlog.event_data.CommandLine:(*\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\dllhost.exe))) AND (NOT (winlog.event_data.CommandLine:"" OR (NOT _exists_:winlog.event_data.CommandLine)))
